speaker: charlie
text: Now for today's big feel good moment, and it is a ripper. Organisers behind the twenty thirty two Brisbane Olympics have unveiled early plans for an Olympic Village that runs almost entirely on solar power.

speaker: alice
text: An Olympic Village powered by sunshine, in Queensland, be still my heart. If any state was built for that job it is us, we have got sunshine to burn.

speaker: charlie
text: Exactly, and it would set a genuine benchmark for how future Games get built and powered. Athletes from around the world sleeping under Queensland sunshine, quite literally.

speaker: alice
text: That is a lovely note to finish on. Turtles scouting beaches, batteries humming, reef babies growing and an Olympic Village dreaming big, honestly what a Wednesday.

speaker: charlie
